items.text: Terry Nguyen Le is a home caregiver. He graduated from Amundsen High School and attended the University of Illinois at Chicago. He served in the Army National Guard and has worked for family-owned businesses and corporations. He is a care specialist for the Chinese Mutual Aid Association. His platform includes reducing the number of local government units. He supports cutting taxes and regulation to spur economic growth. He also supports expanding school choice and parental rights in curriculum.
